name: thinkcomposer
description: Work with ThinkComposer .tcom/.tdom packages, authoritative root JSON, CLI validation, Git links, reports, output generation, logs, and view images.

interface.shortDescription: Patch .tcom/.tdom JSON and use the CLI
interface.longDescription: ThinkComposer lets Codex collaborate with the desktop diagramming app by reading modern .tcom/.tdom packages with authoritative root JSON and previews, patching package JSON directly, preserving Git sync manifest metadata, using the ThinkComposer CLI for package inspection, validation, Git pull/push, PDF/XPS reports, and output-template generation, inspecting copied application logs, and finding embedded or exported view images for visual verification.
